blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Physical understanding is crucial for decision making, yet vision models struggle to infer properties such as damping that govern how materials behave. Audio encodes such properties directly, because an object's acoustic response to impact reveals its damping through measurable decay. We probe frozen encoders for the quality factor $Q$, a dimensionless measure of how many oscillations an object completes before its ring dies away, and report how well each embedding orders impacts by $Q$ using the Spearman rank correlation $ρ$, for which $ρ=1$ is a perfect ordering and $ρ=0$ an unrelated one. Audio embeddings reach $ρ=0.73$ and retain most of that advantage on materials withheld from training, while a single video frame taken at the moment of impact, encoded by CLIP, supports only $ρ=0.28$. Having established where the signal lives, we ask how much of that gap vision can recover. We distill a frozen audio teacher into a frozen CLIP backbone through a trained projection head and find that this recovers a useful fraction of the audio advantage. Because pooled correlations on this task are dominated in practice by category identity, we also evaluate under a leave-one-material-out protocol in which the held-out material is withheld from the projection head as well as the probe. Distillation with a four-frame input improves the correlation there from 0.234 to 0.338 (+0.053 over the matched four-frame baseline, 14 of 17 materials), a gain that no category-level strategy can produce. Widening the visual input to four frames spanning the impact supplies half of that improvement at no acoustic cost, which indicates that part of what a single frame misses is visible dynamics.
blocks.zh: 物理理解对决策至关重要,但视觉模型却难以推断出诸如规范材料行为方式的筑坝等属性。 音频直接编码这些属性,因为一个物体对撞击的声学反应揭示出它通过可测量的衰变而起锚. 我们调查了质量因子$Q$的被冻结编码器,这是衡量一个物体在环被关闭之前完成多少振荡的无维度尺度,并报告每个嵌入命令使用Spearman的分级关系$&$受到多大程度的冲击,对于这个关系,$&$$是一个完美的订单,而$&$是一个无关的订单. 音频嵌入达到0.73美元,保留了培训材料的大部分优势,而由CLIP编码的撞击时拍摄的单一视频帧仅支持0.28美元。 在确定了信号所在位置之后,我们询问这一差距的愿景中有多少可以恢复。 我们通过一个训练有素的投影头 将一个被冷冻的音频老师 提炼成一个被冷冻的CLIP骨干 发现这能恢复音频优势的一小部分 由于与这项任务的集合关联在实践中以类别身份为主,因此我们还根据一项 " 一分即出 " 的协议进行评估,在该协议中,搁置的材料从投影头和探测器中被扣下。 采用四边框输入的分馏可改善其中的关联性,从0.234到0.338(比对应的四边框基线多出0.053分,即17个材料中的14分),这一收益是没有任何类别级战略能够产生的。 将视觉输入拓宽到横跨撞击的四帧,可以提供一半的这种改进而无需声学成本,这表明一个帧漏掉的部分是可见动态.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A robot clearing a table observes two cups that look alike, one ceramic and one plastic. A vision model might correctly label their materials, but this categorical distinction does not reveal how they behave, since the ceramic cup shatters when dropped while the plastic cup bounces. Without physical grounding, vision cannot predict these divergent futures.
blocks.zh: 一个清理桌子的机器人观察到两个杯子, 一个是陶瓷,一个是塑料。 一个视觉模型可能正确地标注了它们的材料,但这种绝对的区别并不能揭示它们的行为方式,因为陶瓷杯在塑料杯反弹时被抛下时会碎裂. 没有物理基础,视力无法预测这些不同的未来。

blocks.en: This appearance–reality gap pervades modern computer vision. Large vision models achieve strong recognition performance, but what they encode is how things look rather than how things behave. Physics benchmarks confirm this gap. PhysBench ( Chow et al., 2025 ) found that GPT-4o achieves only 46.99% on physical dynamics (49.49% overall, against 95.87% for humans), and Physion++ ( Tung et al., 2023 ) showed that all models remain well below human performance on latent properties such as mass, friction, or elasticity.
blocks.zh: 这种外观-现实差距贯穿现代计算机视觉. 大型视觉模型实现了强烈的识别性能,但它们编码的是事物的外观,而不是事物的行为. 物理基准证实了这一差距。 Phys Bench(Chow等人,2025年)发现,GPT-4o在物理动力学上只取得了46.99%的成绩(总体为49.49%,而人类为95.87%),Physion++(Tung等人,2023年)显示,所有模型在质量,摩擦或弹性等潜在特性上都远远低于人类性能.

blocks.en: Audio captures what appearance does not. An object’s acoustic response to impact is governed by physical laws: stiffness, density, and geometry set the resonant frequency, and internal friction, radiation, and mounting set the damping. We confirm the gap directly. Frozen audio embeddings predict the quality factor Q Q at ρ = 0.73 \rho=0.73 , while a single CLIP-encoded video frame taken at the moment of impact supports only ρ = 0.28 \rho=0.28 . Here Q Q is a dimensionless measure of how many oscillations a struck object completes before its ring dies away, so a highly resonant glass has a large Q Q and a heavily damped cloth a small one. We write ρ \rho for the Spearman rank correlation between predicted and true values: ρ = 1 \rho=1 means the model orders impacts by Q Q perfectly, and ρ = 0 \rho=0 means its ordering carries no information about the truth. We use ρ \rho throughout because we care about whether a model can rank objects by how much they ring, not about the absolute scale of its predictions. Our question is the narrower one of how far a frozen visual encoder can be pushed toward the audio number.
blocks.zh: 音频能捕捉到外表上没有的东西。 物体对撞击的声学反应受物理定律的制约:硬度、密度和几何设置共振频率,以及内部摩擦、辐射和升降设置。 我们直接确认差距。 冷冻音频嵌入在 ^ = 0.73\rho=0.73时预测质量系数Q,而撞击时拍摄的单个CLIP编码视频帧仅支持 ^ = 0.28\rho=0.28. 这里Q Q是衡量一个被击中的物体在环死前完成多少个振荡的无维度量,因此高度共振的玻璃有一个大QQ和一个大坝布是一个小的. 我们为 Spearman 的排序在预测值和真实值之间的关联写 ^\rho : ^ = 1\rho= 1 表示模型命令 Q 完美撞击, ^ = 0\rho=0 表示其命令没有包含关于真相的信息 。 我们一直使用 $\rho , 因为我们关心一个模型能否按它们环绕多少来排列对象, 而不是它的预测的绝对尺度。 我们的问题是,一个冷冻的视觉编码器能向音频号码推到多远。

blocks.en: Our answer is that it can be pushed a useful fraction of the way. We distill from a frozen audio teacher into a frozen CLIP encoder, training a projection head as the only new component, and measure the outcome under a protocol in which knowing the material category earns nothing: correlations are computed within a material that was held out from the projection head and from the probe alike. Distillation improves prediction there for most of the 17 materials. Part of this improvement needs no audio at all, since giving the encoder four frames spanning the impact, so that it can see the object deform and recoil, supplies about half. Most of the audio signal nonetheless stays out of reach, which we take to mark the interesting part of the problem rather than a settled question.
blocks.zh: 我们的答案是,它可以被推向一条有用的路。 我们从一个冷冻的音效老师中提炼成一个冷冻的CLIP编码器,训练一个投影头作为唯一的新组件,并根据一个协议来测量结果,在该协议中,了解物质类别是一无所获的:关联性是在从投影头和探测器中都持有的材料中计算出来的。 对17种材料中的大部分材料而言,蒸馏能改善预测。 部分改进不需要任何音频,因为给编码器四个框架横跨撞击,这样它就能看到物体变形和后坐力,供给大约一半. 然而,大多数音频信号仍无法达到,我们把它当作问题中令人感兴趣的部分,而不是一个已经解决的问题。

blocks.en: 1.1 Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.1 缴款

blocks.en: • We propose probing frozen encoders for a continuous physical property, the quality factor Q Q , rather than for the categorical material labels used in prior evaluations. Our measurements show that audio embeddings predict Q Q at ρ = 0.73 \rho=0.73 whereas a single CLIP frame reaches 0.28, that this audio advantage persists for materials withheld from training ( ρ ≈ 0.60 \rho\approx 0.60 ), and that every visual encoder we test is near chance at ranking objects within wood, ceramic, and plastic and reaches at most 0.36 within metal. • We show that part of the visual shortfall is temporal rather than material. Four frames spanning the impact raise vision-only prediction on unseen materials by 0.051 without any acoustic supervision, which suggests that some of what a single frame misses is visible dynamics rather than hidden material structure. • We propose distilling a frozen audio teacher into a frozen visual encoder through a trained projection head, and our experiments demonstrate that this moves a useful fraction of the signal across. The distilled CLIP encoder reaches ρ = 0.44 \rho=0.44 on Q Q and, with a four-frame input, improves prediction from 0.234 to 0.338 on materials withheld from the head as well as the probe (+0.104, 15 of 17 materials, p = 0.002 p=0.002 ; +0.053 over the matched four-frame baseline, 14 of 17 materials). • We report controls that establish where this gain comes from. A capacity ablation, a shuffled-teacher control, and a material-label reference together attribute most of the improvement to acoustic correspondence rather than to added parameters or category recognition. We also document the experimental choices that inflate such measurements when these controls are absent.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提议为连续的物理财产,即质量系数QQ,而不是为先前评估中使用的绝对材料标签,探测冻结编码器。 我们的测量结果表明,音频嵌入预测Q = 0.73\rho=0.73,而一个单一的CLIP框架达到0.28,这种音频优势对不用于培训的材料持续存在( ^ 0.60\rho\ 约0.60),我们测试的每个视觉编码器几乎都有可能在木材、陶瓷和塑料内部对物体进行排名,并在金属内部达到最多0.36。 我们表明,视觉缺陷的一部分是时间性的,而不是物质性的。 横跨撞击的4个框架在没有声学监督的情况下,使0.051对不见材料的仅视预测值上升,这表明一个框架漏掉的一些是可见动态而不是隐藏的物质结构。 我们建议通过一个训练有素的投影头将一个冷冻的音频老师蒸馏成一个冷冻的视觉编码器,我们的实验表明,这能移动一个有用的信号的一小部分。 蒸馏的CLIP编码器在Q上达到ρ = 0.44\rho=0.44,经过四帧输入,对头部和探测器所扣材料的预测从0.234提高到0.338(+0.104,17种材料中的15种,p=0.002p=0.002;与对应的四帧基线相比,17种材料中的14种). • 支助 我们报告控制,以确定这一收益的来源。 能力衰减,洗牌教师控制,以及材料标签的参考,将大部分改进归结为声学对应,而不是附加参数或类别识别. 我们还记录了在缺乏这些控制的情况下增加这种测量的试验选择。

Our measurements show that audio embeddings predict Q Q at ρ = 0.73 \rho=0.73 whereas a single CLIP frame reaches 0.28, that this audio advantage persists for materials withheld from training ( ρ ≈ 0.60 \rho\approx 0.60 ), and that every visual encoder we test is near chance at ranking objects within wood, ceramic, and plastic and reaches at most 0.36 within metal.

Four frames spanning the impact raise vision-only prediction on unseen materials by 0.051 without any acoustic supervision, which suggests that some of what a single frame misses is visible dynamics rather than hidden material structure.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Impact sounds encode material properties that appearance cannot reveal. Owens et al. (2016a) established this connection with the Greatest Hits dataset, demonstrating that visual models can learn to predict impact sounds. RealImpact ( Clarke et al., 2023 ) extends this with force profiles and calibrated measurements. ObjectFolder ( Gao et al., 2023 ) quantifies the relative contributions of vision, audio, and touch for material understanding, finding that audio often provides complementary information. In robotics, audio frequently outperforms vision for physical property estimation: Thankaraj and Pinto (2023) show that auditory feedback improves manipulation, and SonicSense ( Liu and Chen, 2024 ) demonstrates object perception through acoustic vibration. We connect this evidence to representation learning: if audio encodes physics, can this structure be distilled into vision?
blocks.zh: 撞击声编码了外观无法揭示的物质属性. Owens等人(2016年a)与"最伟大的Hits"数据集建立了这种联系,表明视觉模型可以学习预测撞击声. RealImpact(Clarke等人,2023年)扩展了这个功能剖面和校准测量. ObjectFolder (Gao et al., 2023)量化了视觉,音频,和触觉对材料理解的相对贡献,发现音频经常提供补充信息. 在机器人学中,音频经常超过物理属性估计的视觉:Clearaj和Pinto(2023年)显示听觉反馈能改进操纵,SonicSense(刘和陈,2024年)通过声波振动来显示物体感知. 我们把这个证据与表现学习联系起来:如果音频编码物理学,这个结构能被蒸馏成视觉吗?

blocks.en: Joint audio-visual embeddings have evolved from contrastive methods ( Arandjelović and Zisserman, 2017 ; Owens and Efros, 2018 ) to masked autoencoders ( Gong et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2023 ) . PE-AV ( Vyas et al., 2025 ) scales to 100M pairs, achieving state-of-the-art results on audio-visual retrieval. ImageBind ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ) aligns six modalities through image-paired data. Prior work evaluates these models on retrieval and classification, but, to our knowledge, none probes what frozen audio-visual embeddings capture about physical properties, or whether this knowledge can transfer to vision alone.
blocks.zh: 联合视听嵌入法从对比法(Arandjelović和Zisserman,2017年;Owens和Efros,2018年)演变为蒙面自动编码器(Gong等人,2023年;Huang等人,2023年). PE-AV(Vyas等人,2025年)天平到100M对天平,在视听检索上取得最新成果. ImageBind(Girdhar等人,2023年)通过图像投影数据对六个模式进行对齐. 先前的工作评估了这些模型的检索和分类,但据我们所知,没有一项研究能够发现什么是冷冻的视听嵌入物,或者这种知识是否能够单独转移到视觉上。

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks reveal systematic failures in physical reasoning. Beyond PhysBench ( Chow et al., 2025 ) , Physion ( Bear et al., 2021 ) shows that models fall short of humans at predicting physical outcomes, Physion++ ( Tung et al., 2023 ) extends this to outcomes that depend on latent properties, and CLEVRER ( Yi et al., 2020 ) and IntPhys ( Riochet et al., 2021 ) probe causal and intuitive physics understanding. These benchmarks focus on dynamics prediction, and we complement them by probing continuous material properties.
blocks.zh: 最近的基准揭示了物理推理的系统性失败. Beyond Phys Bench (Chow等人,2025年), Physion (Bear等人,2021年)显示模型在预测物理结果时比人类还差,Physion++. (Tung等人, 2023年)将其延伸至取决于潜伏性能的结果,CLEVRER(Yi等人,2020年)和IntPhys(Riochet等人,2021年)探测因果和直觉物理理解. 这些基准侧重于动态预测,我们通过探测连续的物质特性来补充这些基准.

blocks.en: Audio and vision have long supervised one another: ambient sound can train visual representations ( Owens et al., 2016b ) , and visual networks can train sound representations ( Aytar et al., 2016 ) . Knowledge distillation transfers representations across architectures ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) or modalities: Gupta et al. (2016) transferred supervision from labeled RGB images to depth and optical-flow representations. Our work differs in targeting specific physically relevant structure rather than general representations, and takes a step toward making acoustically grounded properties partially accessible to vision alone.
blocks.zh: 音频和视觉长期互相监督:环境声音可以训练视觉表现(Owens等人,2016b),视觉网络可以训练声音表现(Aytar等人,2016). 知识蒸馏转移了跨架构的表示(Hinton等人,2015年)或模式:Gupta等人(2016年)将监督从标注的RGB图像转移到深度和光学流表示. 我们的工作在针对具体的与物理相关的结构而不是一般的表述方面有所不同,并迈出了一步,使部分基于声学的特性能够单独进入视觉。

blocks.en: 3 The Quality Factor: A Continuous Physical Property
blocks.zh: 3 质量因素:连续的实体财产

blocks.en: 3.1 Why Q Q ?
blocks.zh: 3.1 为什么是QQ?

blocks.en: The quality factor Q = π ​ f 0 / β Q=\pi f_{0}/\beta combines resonant frequency ( f 0 f_{0} ) and damping rate ( β \beta ) into one dimensionless scalar. The damping rate β \beta sets how quickly a ringing object falls silent in absolute time, whereas Q Q counts how many oscillation cycles it completes before decaying, so a high-pitched glass can fall silent sooner than a lower-pitched metal bowl while having the higher Q Q .
blocks.zh: 质量系数Q= π f 0 / β Q=\ pi f_{0}/\β 结合共振频率 (f 0 f_{0}) 和坝率 (β\β) 组成一个无维的阶梯. 凸起速率β\β设定一个振铃物体在绝对时间下沉静的速率,而QQ则计算它在衰变前完成多少振铃周期,因此高振铃玻璃比低振铃金属碗更早沉静,同时拥有更高的QQ.

blocks.en: We target this compound quantity for three reasons. Being dimensionless, Q Q is comparable across objects regardless of size or pitch, so a wine glass and a steel beam can share a Q Q despite frequencies orders of magnitude apart. It also varies continuously within material categories: a thin metal sheet and a solid metal block are both “metal” yet differ substantially in Q Q , so predicting it demands more than category recognition. Finally, it has direct physical consequences, determining whether an object rings, bounces, or absorbs energy on impact. These properties make Q Q a stricter test of physical grounding than frequency, which is largely predictable from visible geometry, or the damping rate alone, which is confounded with object size.
blocks.zh: 我们针对这个复合体的数量有三个原因。 作为无维度,无论大小或投球,QQ在物体之间都是可比较的,因此酒杯和钢梁尽管频率的量级相差很大,仍可以共享Q. 它在材料类别中也不断不同:薄的金属板和固体金属块都是“金属”,但在QQ中差别很大,因此预测它要求的不仅仅是类别识别。 最后,它具有直接的物理后果,决定一个物体是环,反弹,还是在撞击时吸收能量. 这些属性使QQ成为比频率更严格的物理搁浅测试,从可见几何学上来说,这在很大程度上是可以预测的,或者仅靠与物体大小相混淆的拦坝率.

blocks.en: 3.2 Extraction Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 提取管道

blocks.en: We extract Q Q from audio recordings in the Greatest Hits dataset ( Owens et al., 2016a ) , which contains 977 videos of objects being hit with a drumstick. Our copy carries annotations for 975, totaling 28,444 individual impacts across 17 material categories.
blocks.zh: 我们从Greatest Hits数据集(Owens et al., 2016a)的录音中提取Q Q,该数据集包含977个物体被鼓棒击中的视频. 我们的副本载有975份说明,共计28 444份个人撞击,涉及17个材料类别。

blocks.en: Figure 1 illustrates both the quantity and the method. For each annotated impact, we take the magnitude of the analytic signal (the Hilbert envelope) to obtain an amplitude envelope A ⁡ ( t ) A(t) and fit the decay model A ⁡ ( t ) = A 0 ​ e − β ​ t + C A(t)=A_{0}e^{-\beta t}+C by nonlinear least squares, with β \beta bounded to [ 0.1 , 1000 ] [0.1,1000] s -1 and the additive constant C C absorbing background noise. The resonant frequency f 0 f_{0} is the dominant peak of the power spectrum above 50 Hz, a floor that avoids low-frequency room noise. Retaining only fits with R 2 ≥ 0.8 R^{2}\geq 0.8 leaves 17,958 usable impacts, 63% of the total. Rejections concentrate on granular and scattering surfaces, where the response has no single resonant mode to fit: water retains 24% of its annotated impacts, gravel 33%, and dirt 36%, against 83% for cloth and 91% for glass. We return to this selection effect in Section 8 .
blocks.zh: 图1说明了数量和方法。 对于每次附加说明的撞击,我们取分析信号(希尔伯特信封)的大小,以获得振幅信封A_(t)A(t),并符合衰变模型A_(t)=A0 e_(β)_(t)+C(t)=A_(_{0)}e_(o)-(o)\(o)\(o)=C,以非线性最小的方形,β\(b)\(b)与[0.1,1000] [0.1,100]s-1和添加式C常数吸收背景噪音. 共振频率f 0 f_{0}是50赫兹以上的功率频谱的主要峰值,这一层避免了低频室噪声. 保留只符合R2 → 0.8 R^{2 → 0.8 留下17,958个可用撞击,占总数的63%。 拒绝集中在颗粒状表面和散落表面,在这种表面,反应没有单一的共振模式可以适应:水保留了24%的附加说明的撞击、33%的砾石和36%的泥土,布料为83%,玻璃为91%。 我们回到第8节的这一选择效果。

blocks.en: 3.3 Validation
blocks.zh: 3.3 验证

blocks.en: The extracted values match physical expectation. Median Q Q rises monotonically from the soft, absorptive materials to the resonant ones: cloth 15, carpet 23, wood 55, plastic 89, metal 134, ceramic 327, glass 412. This ordering is consistent with the extraction capturing physically meaningful variation rather than recording artifacts.
blocks.zh: 提取值符合物理预期 。 中位Q Q 单调从柔软的,吸收性的材料上升到共振性的材料:布15,地毯23,木质55,塑料89,金属134,陶瓷327,玻璃412. 这种订单符合提取物,而不是记录文物。

blocks.en: Figure 1: What Q Q measures, and how we transfer it. (a) Example impacts from the Greatest Hits dataset: a drumstick strike shown at the frame of contact, with example Q Q values ranging from 223 (glass) to 15 (cloth); per-material medians are given in Section 3.3 . (b) Hilbert envelopes plotted against time show that absolute duration is governed by the damping rate β \beta : the metal bowl ( β = 14 \beta=14 s -1 ) rings longest even though glass has the higher Q Q . (c) Plotted against elapsed oscillation cycles t ​ f 0 tf_{0} , the ordering follows Q Q , with cloth and wood falling silent within tens of cycles while glass and metal persist past two hundred. Q Q therefore measures the quality of resonance rather than its duration. (d) The distillation setup: both encoders stay frozen and only the projection head is trained, with a symmetric InfoNCE objective. No Q Q label enters training, and the ridge probe used for evaluation is fit afterward on held-out videos.
blocks.zh: 图1:QQ量度,如何转移. (a) 来自 " 最大打击 " 数据集的实例:在接触框上显示的鼓棒击打,例如QQ值从223(玻璃)到15(服装);每个物质中位数见第3.3节。 (b) Hilbert 信封按时间绘制,显示绝对持续时间受坝率β\β的支配:金属碗(β=14\β=14 s-1)环最长,即使玻璃的QQ最高。 (c) 与经过的振荡周期t f 0 tf_{0} 定单遵循Q Q,布和木材在数十个周期内沉寂,而玻璃和金属持续超过200个周期。 因此,Q衡量共振的质量而不是持续时间。 (d) 蒸馏装置:两种编码器都保持冷冻,只有投影头经过训练,具有对称的InfoNCE目标. 没有QQ标签进入训练,用于评价的山脊探测器在被搁置的视频上之后是合适的.

blocks.en: 4 Physical Structure in Audio-Visual Embeddings
blocks.zh: 4 视听嵌入体的物质结构

blocks.en: 4.1 Models Evaluated
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价的模式

blocks.en: We probe four frozen encoders. Two are audio-visual: PE-AV ( Vyas et al., 2025 ) , trained contrastively on 100M audio-visual pairs and exposing separate audio, video, and joint embeddings, and CAV-MAE ( Gong et al., 2023 ) , a masked autoencoder trained on AudioSet ( Gemmeke et al., 2017 ) with both reconstruction and contrastive objectives. Two are vision-only: CLIP ViT-L/14 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , trained on 400M image–text pairs, and DINOv2 ViT-L/14 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , trained by self-distillation on curated images without language supervision. The latter pair represents the two dominant recipes for general-purpose visual features, and neither has any acoustic exposure. Video inputs are single frames taken at the annotated moment of impact, each encoded as an image, and audio inputs are 2-second clips centered on the impact.
blocks.zh: 我们探测了四个冷冻编码器 二是视听:PE-AV(Vyas et al.,2025年),对100M的视听对子进行了对比性培训,并曝光了独立的音频,视频和联合嵌入,以及CAV-MAE(Gong et al.,2023年),一个蒙面自动编码器,对AudioSet(Gemmeke et al.,2017年)进行了对比性培训,既具有重建和对比性目标. 二只是视觉:CLIP ViT-L/14(拉德福德等人,2021年),接受过400M图像-文本对子培训,DINov2 ViT-L/14(Oquab等人,2024年),在没有语言监督的情况下,通过自行消化处理的图像培训. 后一对代表了通用视觉特征的两种主要食谱,两者都没有声波曝光. 视频输入是附加说明的撞击时刻拍摄的单帧,每帧编码为图像,音频输入为以撞击为中心的2秒片段.

blocks.en: 4.2 Probing Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.2 探测议定书

blocks.en: We train ridge regression ( λ = 1.0 \lambda=1.0 ) from frozen embeddings to log ⁡ ( Q + 1 ) \log(Q+1) and evaluate with Spearman ρ \rho . Pooled correlations carry 95% bootstrap intervals over samples (1,000 resamples). Leave-one-material-out figures are means over the 17 held-out materials, and their intervals resample the materials rather than the samples (10,000 resamples), which is why they are wider.
blocks.zh: 我们从冷冻嵌入式(Q = 1.0\lambda = 1.0)训练脊回归式(Q = 1.0\lambda = 1.0)到对准式(Q + 1)\log(Q+1),并与 Spearman ^\rho 一同评价. 串联的关联带95%的靴子间隔在样品上(1 000个复标)。 留一材料的数字是指17种被搁置的材料,它们之间的间隔对材料进行重新取样,而不是对样品进行重新取样(10 000个复标),因此它们的范围更广。

blocks.en: 4.3 Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 结果

blocks.en: Table 1: Audio embeddings capture the quality factor Q \boldsymbol{Q} , while single-frame vision largely does not. Spearman ρ \rho between ridge-probe predictions from frozen embeddings and ground-truth Q Q , on the held-out video split.
blocks.zh: 表1:音频嵌入获取质量因子 Q\boldsymbol{Q} ,而单帧视觉基本没有. Spearman ^\rho 从冷冻的嵌入和地面真实QQ的预测之间, 在被搁置的视频分割。

blocks.en: Table 1 reports the result. The gap between audio ( ρ = 0.73 \rho=0.73 ) and CLIP vision ( ρ = 0.28 \rho=0.28 ) quantifies physical structure that frozen single-frame visual encoders do not linearly expose. Co-training on audio does not by itself place that structure in the visual pathway: PE-AV’s video branch reaches 0.362 and CAV-MAE’s only 0.151, both far below their own audio branches, and the two models differ in architecture, data scale, and objective, none of which this comparison controls. We therefore treat the audio results as motivation for pushing structure into a frozen visual encoder deliberately, rather than as evidence that co-training supplies it for free.
blocks.zh: 表1报告了结果。 音频(^ 0.73\rho=0.73)和CLIP视觉(^ 0.28\rho=0.28)的间隙将物理结构量化为被冻结的单帧视觉编码器不会线性曝光. PE-AV的视频分支达到0.362, CAV-MAE只有0.151, 两者都远远低于各自的音频分支, 两种模式在架构、数据尺度和客观方面都不相同, 因此,我们把音频结果视为是故意将结构推向冷冻的视觉编码器的动机,而不是共同训练免费提供的证据.

blocks.en: 5 Generalization Across and Within Materials
blocks.zh: 5 材料综述

blocks.en: 5.1 Leave-One-Material-Out (LOMO)
blocks.zh: 5.1 离家出走(LOMO)

blocks.en: High correlation on the full dataset could reflect material-specific memorization. We test generalization: train on 16 materials and evaluate on the held-out 17th.
blocks.zh: 整个数据集的高度相关性可以反映具体材料的记忆。 我们测试概括:在16种材料上进行训练,在被搁置的17号上进行评估.

blocks.en: Table 2: Physical structure generalizes to unseen materials. Mean over the 17 held-out materials, with intervals bootstrapped over materials.
blocks.zh: 表2:物理结构一般化为无形材料。 平均在17个被搁置的材料上,间隔在材料上。

blocks.en: Audio embeddings predict Q Q for unseen materials ( ρ ≈ 0.60 \rho\approx 0.60 ; Table 2 ), and joint embeddings reach 0.49–0.57. This is physical generalization: a probe never trained on the held-out material still ranks its impacts by how much they ring, using only their audio embeddings.
blocks.zh: 音频嵌入预测Q对隐形材料的Q(^ 0.60\rho\约0.60;表2),联合嵌入达到0.49-0.57. 这是物理的概括:从未受过被搁置材料训练的探测器仍按其撞击量排列,仅使用其音频嵌入.

blocks.en: 5.2 Within Materials, and Which Component of Q Q
blocks.zh: 5.2 材料内部和Q的哪个组成部分

blocks.en: Two checks ask whether these correlations are really about physics. The first computes ρ \rho within a single material category, where category identity supplies nothing. The modalities separate sharply: PE-AV audio reaches 0.67 on metal and 0.57 on wood, whereas every visual encoder, including PE-AV’s video branch, is at or below 0.36 on metal and close to zero ( | ρ | ≤ 0.19 |\rho|\leq 0.19 ) on wood, ceramic, and plastic. CLIP scores 0.06, 0.03, − - 0.14, and − - 0.19 on metal, wood, ceramic, and plastic. Baseline vision barely distinguishes physical variation among objects of the same material. Table 7 in Appendix B gives the breakdown.
blocks.zh: 有两次检查询问这些关联性是否真的与物理学有关. 第一个计算在单一物质类别中,类别身份不提供任何东西。 PE-AV音频在金属上达到0.67分,在木材上达到0.57分,而包括PE-AV视频分支在内的每个视觉编码器在金属上达到或低于0.36分,在木材、陶瓷和塑料上接近0.19分。 CLIP在金属、木材、陶瓷和塑料方面得分0.06、0.03、−0.14和−0.19。 基线视觉几乎无法区分同一物质物体之间的物理差异。 附录中的表7 B给出了细分。

blocks.en: The second asks which component of Q Q is responsible, since Q = π ​ f 0 / β Q=\pi f_{0}/\beta compounds a spectral term with a damping term, and across our impacts Q Q is strongly rank-correlated with f 0 f_{0} ( ρ = 0.87 \rho=0.87 ) and moderately anti-correlated with β \beta ( ρ = − 0.54 \rho=-0.54 ). An encoder that merely recovered pitch would therefore score well. Probing the targets separately (Appendix A ) shows that the damping term is the one audio captures best: PE-AV audio reaches ρ = 0.729 \rho=0.729 on β \beta against 0.700 on f 0 f_{0} , and the gap widens where category identity stops helping, with β \beta holding at 0.686 on unseen materials while f 0 f_{0} falls to 0.485. Vision shows the opposite pattern at much lower levels, favoring f 0 f_{0} when pooled (0.347 against 0.221), which is consistent with pitch being partly inferable from visible size. The reading we place on Q Q therefore survives being tested directly, and β \beta is the sharper target.
6 Acoustic-to-Visual Distillation
blocks.zh: 6 声学对视觉蒸馏

blocks.en: 6.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 设置

blocks.en: The teacher is the frozen PE-AV audio encoder, which predicts Q Q at ρ = 0.73 \rho=0.73 . The student is CLIP ViT-L/14, also frozen, with a trainable three-layer MLP head (GELU, LayerNorm, 1024-dimensional output) as the only component that learns. Its input is four frames taken at − 0.1 -0.1 , 0, + 0.1 +0.1 , and + 0.2 +0.2 s around the annotated impact, each encoded independently and concatenated with their successive differences. Training minimizes a symmetric InfoNCE loss ( van den Oord et al., 2018 ) between the projected visual embedding and the teacher’s audio embedding ( τ = 0.07 \tau=0.07 ), with batch size 256 and AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) at a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} .
blocks.zh: 老师是冷冻的PE-AV音频编码器,该编码器预言Q = 0.73\rho=0.73 . 学生是CLIP VIT-L/14,同样是冷冻的,有一个可训练的三级MLP头(GELU,LayerNorm,1024维输出)作为唯一学习的组件. 其输入方式为−0.1-0.1,0,+0.1+0.1,+0.2+0.2 s围绕注解撞击的4个帧,每个帧独立编码,并与其相继差异相配合. 训练将预测的视觉嵌入和老师的音频嵌入(τ=0.07\tau=0.07)之间的对称InfoNCE损失最小化(van den Oord et al., 2018),批量大小为256和AdamW(Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019),学习速度为10−4 10^{-4}.

blocks.en: Because the space of plausible configurations is large, we fixed the feature variant and the number of epochs on a validation split drawn from 20% of the training videos (which selected the four frames + deltas input, trained for two epochs) and used the test split for no selection, reporting three seeds. One detail of the data handling carries more weight than it may appear to. We use the dataset’s video-level split throughout and train the head on training-split impacts only (22,793 of 28,444 impacts, from 780 of 975 videos), because the teacher’s own embeddings predict Q Q at ρ = 0.73 \rho=0.73 : any impact seen during distillation has effectively had its target leaked, even though no Q Q label is ever used.
blocks.zh: 由于假想配置的空间很大,我们从20%的训练视频(选择了四个框架+三角洲输入,训练了两个时代)中提取的验证分数上,固定了特征变体和时间段数,并使用测试分数不选择,报告三个种子. 数据处理的一个细节比看起来更为重要。 我们使用整个数据集的视频平面分解并训练头部只进行训练平面撞击(28,444次撞击中的22,793次,从975次视频中的780次),因为老师自己的嵌入预言QQ在 ^ = 0.73\rho= 0.73:在蒸馏过程中看到的任何撞击都有效泄露了目标,尽管从未使用过QQ标签.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Why pooled correlation is a weak measure of physical understanding. Predicted against true Q Q on the held-out split ( n = 3,510 n=3{,}510 ), with predictions standardized to the target scale and the diagonal shown for reference. Left: a single frame at impact supports only a weak trend. Middle: after distillation, the cloud tightens appreciably. This panel shows the first, and highest, of the three seeds ( ρ = 0.466 \rho=0.466 , against the three-seed mean of 0.440 in Table 3 ). Right: mapping the true material label to its per-category median Q Q produces just 17 distinct predictions, visible as horizontal bands, and still reaches ρ = 0.430 \rho=0.430 . A model that cannot separate two metal objects at all therefore scores almost as well on this measure as our distilled encoder, which is why the argument rests on Section 6.4 instead.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 集合关联为什么是物理理解的弱度度量. 相对于被搁置的拆分(n = 3,510 n = 3{,}510)上的真实QQ进行预测,预测标准为目标尺度,对角显示以供参考. 左侧:撞击时的单个框架只支持微弱的趋势. 中间:蒸馏后,云会明显收紧. 本面板显示三种种子中的第一种,也是最高的(^ 0.466\rho=0.466,而表3中的三种子平均值为0.440). 右:将真实材料标签映射到其每类中位Q Q仅产生17种不同的预测,可见为水平波段,仍然达到ρ=0.430\rho=0.430. 因此,一个完全无法分离出两个金属物体的模型在这个尺度上得分几乎与我们蒸馏的编码器相同,这就是为什么这一论点要靠6.4节。

blocks.en: 6.2 How Much of the Gap Is Temporal?
blocks.zh: 6.2 时间差距有多大?

blocks.en: Before introducing audio at all, we ask whether a single frame is the right visual input. A struck object deforms and recoils, and how quickly that motion subsides is what damping describes.
blocks.zh: 在引入音频之前,我们先询问单个帧是否是正确的视觉输入. 被击中的物体变形和后坐力 运动的减速速度是坝平描述的

blocks.en: Table 3: 𝑸 \boldsymbol{Q} prediction from vision on the held-out video split, with and without distillation from the audio teacher.
blocks.zh: 表3:Q\boldsymbol QQ从被搁置的视频分拆上的视觉预测,有和没有音频老师的蒸馏.

blocks.en: Widening the window helps, but only modestly on the pooled measure: ρ \rho rises from 0.281 to 0.298 (0.299 without deltas), with overlapping intervals. The effect is clearer under the LOMO protocol of Section 6.4 , where the same change is worth +0.051 (0.234 to 0.285). We therefore treat the temporal contribution as modest, while noting that it costs no acoustic supervision whatsoever.
blocks.zh: 拓宽窗口有帮助,但在集合度量上却微乎其微: ^\rho从0.281上升至0.298(0.299没有三角洲),间隔重叠. 根据6.4节的LOMO协议,效果更明显,同一修改值+0.051(0.234到0.285). 因此,我们把时间性贡献视为微不足道,同时指出,它不需要任何声学监督。

blocks.en: 6.3 Distillation Results
blocks.zh: 6.3 蒸馏结果

blocks.en: Distillation raises vision-only Q Q prediction to 0.440, from 0.298 with the same four-frame input and no teacher. This is marginally above the 0.430 obtainable from perfect material-category knowledge and still far below the audio teacher. Because the pooled measure is dominated in practice by category information, exceeding that reference by 0.01, which lies inside the three-seed range, is not conclusive (Figure 2 ), so we turn to a measure under which category identity earns nothing.
blocks.zh: 沉淀使只有视觉的Q Q预测从相同的四帧输入和没有老师的0.298提高到0.440. 这略高于从完美的材料类知识中获得的0.430,但仍远远低于音频教师。 由于集合措施在实践中以类别信息为主,超过位于三种子范围内的0.01的引用,不是结论性措施(图2),因此我们转而考虑类别身份无所得的计量.

blocks.en: 6.4 Leave-One-Material-Out, with the Head Held Out
blocks.zh: 6.4 " 离开一元 " ,头部被吊出

blocks.en: LOMO is the discriminating test, because correlations are computed within a held-out material: a model that outputs a category’s median Q Q predicts a constant there and is scored zero, since Spearman ρ \rho is undefined for constant predictions. Two conditions must both hold for the test to mean anything. The material must be excluded from the probe, and it must also be excluded from the distillation head—otherwise the head has already learned that material’s appearance-to-audio mapping and the probe merely reads it back. We refer to this stricter protocol as true LOMO .
blocks.zh: LOMO是歧视性的测试, 因为关联性是在被搁置的材料中计算出来的: 一个输出一个类别中位的QQ预测一个常数且得分为零的模型, 因为Spireman à\rho对于恒定预测没有定义 。 两个条件必须同时符合测试的意义。 材料必须被排除在探测器之外,还必须排除在蒸馏头之外,否则,该探测器已经知道材料的外观到声波绘图,探测器只读回它。 我们把这更严格的议定书称为真正的LOMO。

blocks.en: Table 4: True LOMO: the held-out material is excluded from the projection head as well as the probe. Mean over 17 materials and three seeds, with intervals bootstrapped over materials.
blocks.zh: 表4:真实的LOMO:被搁置的材料从投影头和探测器中排除。 平均超过17种材料和3种种子,间隔在材料上。

blocks.en: Table 4 reports the outcome. Distillation improves LOMO by +0.104 over the single-frame baseline, with 15 of 17 materials improving (Wilcoxon p = 0.002 p=0.002 ), and by +0.053 over the four-frame baseline, with 14 of 17 improving ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ). The gains are uneven: the five largest (single-frame baseline → \to distilled) are on granular and natural surfaces, namely gravel 0.364 → 0.708 0.364\to 0.708 , grass 0.377 → 0.610 0.377\to 0.610 , dirt 0.285 → 0.605 0.285\to 0.605 , leaf 0.290 → 0.541 0.290\to 0.541 , and rock 0.247 → 0.469 0.247\to 0.469 , which together account for about three-quarters of the total gain.
6.5 Controls
blocks.zh: 6.5 控制措施

blocks.en: Table 5 collects the three controls, which together bound what this result can mean.
blocks.zh: 表5收集了三种控制,这些控制合在一起将这一结果的含义联系在一起。

blocks.en: Table 5: Controls, as pooled ρ \boldsymbol{\rho} on the held-out video split. Correspondence arms hold the seed fixed, so the matched-teacher row is the first, and highest, of the three seeds (0.466) rather than their mean (0.440).
blocks.zh: 表5:控件,作为被搁置的视频分页的集合 $\boldsymbol\rho} 函臂牵着种子固定,所以配对师排是三种种子中第一,也是最高的(0.466),而不是其平均值(0.440).

blocks.en: The first control asks how much of any Q Q correlation is simply material recognition. Mapping the true material to its per-category median Q Q gives ρ = 0.430 \rho=0.430 [0.400, 0.457], and a material classifier trained on CLIP features, at 45.6% accuracy, mapped the same way gives ρ = 0.279 \rho=0.279 [0.246, 0.311]. Any pooled correlation near 0.28 is therefore indistinguishable from category recognition, which is precisely why we rest the argument on LOMO rather than on the pooled figure.
blocks.zh: 第一个控件询问QQ关联中有多少只是物质识别. 将真实材料映射到每类中位Q Q给出 ^ 0.430\rho= 0.430 [0.400, 04.57],并用精度为45.6%的经CLIP特征培训的材料分类器映射出同样的方式给出 ^ 0.279\rho= 0.279 [0.246, 0.311]. 因此,任何接近0.28的集合关系都与类别识别是分不开的,正因为如此,我们才把论据放在LOMO上,而不是集合数字上。

blocks.en: The second asks whether the trainable head is doing the work rather than the teacher. An identically shaped head given direct supervision on log ⁡ ( Q + 1 ) \log(Q+1) , with no audio involved, reaches only ρ = 0.275 \rho=0.275 [0.224, 0.293], below the 0.300 [0.267, 0.330] reached by a linear probe on the same features. Additional parameters buy nothing here: with roughly 14,000 noisy scalar targets, a regression head has little to learn from, whereas the teacher supplies a dense 1024-dimensional target whose geometry already encodes damping.
blocks.zh: 第二问可训练头目是做功课,而不是老师. 在log Q(Q+1)\log(Q+1)上直接给予的形状相同的头部,没有涉及音频,只达到 ρ = 0.275\rho = 0.275 [0.224,0.293],低于线性探测器在同一特性上达到的 0.300 [0.267,0.330] . 其他参数在这里买不到任何东西:在大约14000个吵闹的scalar目标下,一个回归头几乎没有东西可以学习,而老师则提供密集的1024维目标,其几何已经编码成坝。

blocks.en: The third asks whether any structured target would do. Holding the seed fixed, distilling from correctly matched audio reaches ρ = 0.466 \rho=0.466 (the first, and highest, of the three seeds, whose mean is the 0.440 of Table 3 ) against 0.298 with no distillation. Distilling from a fully shuffled teacher (10.6% material agreement) still reaches 0.359, and positional indexing, used by an earlier version of our pipeline (13.3% material agreement), reaches 0.360. Roughly a third of the raw gain therefore survives destroying the correspondence entirely, while the larger part, +0.107, requires the teacher to correspond to the frame it is paired with. Reported gains from cross-modal distillation should be read against a shuffled-teacher control for this reason.
blocks.zh: 第三点询问是否有任何结构化的目标。 将种子固定,从正确配对的音频中蒸馏到 ^ 0.466\rho=0.466 (三种种子中第一种也是最高的,其平均值为表3中的0.440),对0.298没有蒸馏. 完全被甩掉的教师(10.6%)仍然达到0.359,我们较早的管道(13.3%)使用的定位索引达到0.360。 因此,大约三分之一的原始收益能够完全摧毁函证,而较大部分+0.107则要求教师与其配对的框架相对应。 因此,应对照教师的洗牌控制来阅读跨模式蒸馏所得报告。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: Three findings survive the controls. First, damping structure is present in audio and largely absent from single-frame vision, and separating the components of Q Q shows that audio carries the damping term β \beta better than pitch, which is what licenses reading the transferred structure as physical. Second, a frozen visual encoder can acquire part of that structure from a frozen audio teacher without any Q Q label entering training, and the gain holds on materials withheld from the projection head as well as the probe (0.234 to 0.338, 15 of 17 materials), where a category-level strategy earns nothing. Third, roughly half of the improvement needs no audio at all and follows from four frames instead of one, so part of what looks like a limit of vision is a limit of single-frame inputs.
blocks.zh: 3个发现 幸存的控制。 首先,坝顶结构存在于音频中,而且基本上没有出现在单帧视觉中,将Q的组件分开表明,音频比投球更能携带坝顶术语β\β,这就是许可将传输的结构看成物理的. 第二,一个冷冻的视觉编码器可以在没有QQ标签的情况下从一个冷冻的音频教师那里获得该结构的一部分,进入培训阶段,而且从投影头和探测器(17个材料中的0.234至0.338,15个)中扣下的材料的增益,而一个类别一级的策略却一无所获。 第三,大约一半的改进完全不需要音频,而是从四个框架而不是一个框架来进行,因此,视觉极限的一部分似乎是单帧输入的限度。

blocks.en: The effect is modest in absolute terms. Most of the teacher’s signal does not cross, and on the pooled measure the distilled encoder barely exceeds what perfect category knowledge would supply. That comparison is itself the methodological result we would most like carried forward: category identity alone reaches ρ = 0.43 \rho=0.43 on this task, so a pooled number near that value says little about physical understanding. Establishing physical transfer needs an evaluation under which category recognition earns nothing, namely true LOMO, together with a shuffled-teacher control (Section 6.5 ).
blocks.zh: 绝对效果不大。 大部分教师的信号并不交叉,在集合测量中,蒸馏编码器几乎不能超过完美的分类知识所能提供的程度。 这一比较本身就是我们最希望延续的方法结果:光是类别身份就达到 ^ 0.43\rho=0.43, 因此,一个接近这个数值的集合数字对实际理解没有什么意义。 建立物理转移需要一种评估,在这种评估下,对类别进行识别,即真正的LOMO,加上被打乱的教师控制(第6.5节)。

blocks.en: The residual is a concrete target rather than a closed question. Damping depends on internal structure a camera often cannot observe, and the natural next step is β \beta itself, the component audio predicts best, nearly independent of f 0 f_{0} , and the one on which the distilled student already improves most.
blocks.zh: 剩余部分是一个具体目标,而不是一个封闭的问题。 Damping依赖于摄像头经常无法观测的内部结构,自然的下一步是β\β本身,组件音频预测最好,几乎独立于f 0 f_{0},蒸馏学生已经改进最多的一个.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: Four caveats bound these results. First, evaluation is confined to Greatest Hits (977 videos, 17 materials) and to one visual domain, so whether the projection head learns a general appearance-to-damping mapping or associations tied to controlled drumstick footage is unresolved. Second, the R 2 ≥ 0.8 R^{2}\geq 0.8 filter keeps 63% of annotated impacts at strongly material-dependent rates (Section 3.2 ), and the five largest per-material gains of Section 6.4 fall on materials retaining a third to just over a half of their impacts, so those correlations cover a selected minority of each category. The discarded impacts cannot be assessed with Q Q at all, since there the target is undefined. Third, the four-frame model is evaluated on Q Q alone (the f 0 f_{0} / β \beta probe in Appendix A uses a single-frame student), so although probing shows that audio carries β \beta better than f 0 f_{0} (Section 5.2 ), we do not establish transfer of physical structure in general, and properties that impact sound encodes weakly or not at all, such as friction, may behave differently. Finally, we measure transferred structure by probing accuracy alone, so whether better Q Q decodability yields better physical decisions remains to be shown on a task whose outcome is not a function of Q Q .
blocks.zh: 这些结果受四项告诫的约束。 首先,评价仅限于Greatest Hits(977个视频,17个材料)和一个视觉领域,因此投影头是否学习一般的外观对印映图,或者与受控鼓棒镜头捆绑的关联尚未解决. 其次,R2 0.8 R^{2}\ 0.8滤波器保留了63%的注解影响,高度依赖物质(第3.2节),第6.4节中五个最大的每物质收益落在保留三分之一至略高于一半影响的材料上,因此,这些相关性涵盖每个类别中选定的少数。 丢弃的影响完全不能与QQ一起评估,因为目标在那里没有定义. 第三,四帧模型仅在Q上(附录A中的f 0 f_{0}/β\β\β探测器使用单帧学生)进行评价,因此虽然检测显示音频携带β\ββ优于f 0 f_{0}(第5.2节),但我们并不确定一般物理结构的转移,而影响声音编码弱或完全没有的属性,如摩擦,可能表现不同. 最后,我们仅通过测试准确性来衡量转移的结构,因此,对于一个其结果不是Q的功能的任务,是否更好的Q解码性能产生更好的物理决定仍有待于显示。

blocks.en: Two patterns are worth drawing out. First, for both audio encoders and the PE-AV joint embedding, β \beta is predicted better than f 0 f_{0} , and the margin grows under LOMO, which is where category identity stops carrying the prediction. Second, the visual encoders order the targets the other way when pooled, favoring f 0 f_{0} , which is consistent with pitch being partly inferable from visible object size, and that ordering reverses on unseen materials. Under true LOMO, the distilled student improves on both targets and improves most on β \beta ( 0.257 → 0.375 0.257\to 0.375 ), so what transfers is preferentially the damping term rather than the spectral one.
blocks.zh: 两种模式值得画出来. 首先,对于音频编码器和PE-AV联合嵌入器来说,β\β的预测优于f 0 f%\0},比值在LOMO下会增长,而LOMO是类别身份停止携带预测的地方. 其次,视觉编码器在集合时会以相反的方式排列目标,偏好 f 0 f_{0}这与投球部分从可见对象大小推导一致,并命令在看不见的材料上反转. 在真正的LOMO下,被蒸馏的学生在两个目标上都有改进,在β\β(0.257~0.3750.257~0.375)上改进最多,因此哪些转移是优先的筑坝术语而不是光谱术语.
